name: Accidental Discharge (East Face)
approach: The genuine standard approach is from the Downey Creek Trailhead (off Suiattle River Road) via the southern end of the Ptarmigan Traverse — a rugged, largely off-trail alpine route over Itswoot Ridge/Cub Lake and Bachelor Creek involving glacier travel and significant bushwhacking. Climbers typically budget a full day (or two) of approach before reaching the base of South Peak's granite faces; this is an experienced-mountaineers-only objective, not a roadside crag.
itinerary: Day 1: drive to Downey Creek TH and hike ~12-13 mi / ~5,700 ft gain via Bachelor Creek to an Itswoot Ridge camp. Day 2: ~3 mi / ~2,500 ft further to a high camp near the Dome-Chickamin col (~8,500 ft). Day 3: cross the Chickamin/Blue Glacier to the base of the East Face and climb; return to high camp. Days 4-5: reverse the approach.

waypoints.name: Downey Creek Trailhead
waypoints.note: Corrected - previous waypoints incorrectly placed this route ~59 miles away at Amphitheater Mountain (Pasayten Wilderness), a research error. South Peak is actually part of the Gunsight Range, Glacier Peak Wilderness - same remote 2-day approach as Middle Peak (Downey/Bachelor Creek trail to Itswoot Ridge, Dome-Chickamin col, Chickamin Glacier).
waypoints.directions: From SR 530 about 8 mi north of Darrington, turn east on the Suiattle River Road (FS Road 26) and follow it about 20 mi to the Downey Creek Trailhead at about 1,440 ft. Park on the south side of the road just past the Downey Creek bridge; the trail starts on the north side. A Northwest Forest Pass or day pass is required. The road has a long history of washouts, so check its status first.

waypoints.name: South Peak (Gunsight Range)
waypoints.note: The southernmost of four named summits (Northeast/North/Middle/South) along one short ridge crest, reached last in a north-to-south traverse after Middle Peak. This coordinate is a geometric estimate about 0.2mi south of Middle Peak along the ridge, not a surveyed fix.
